info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-Delete Logistics Shipments Cancel-v4-spec
info.description: The Cancel Logistics Shipments API allows businesses to efficiently manage and cancel pending shipments within their logistics operations. This endpoint is essential for users who need to retract shipment orders due to changes in logistics or customer requests. Typical consumers include logistics managers and customer service representatives, who may require quick action on cancelled shipments to optimize delivery processes. Leverage this API to enhance operational agility and improve customer satisfaction by responding promptly to shipment cancellations.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel a shipment that has been previously created. It is essential to ensure that the shipment is eligible for cancellation based on its current status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel a shipment. Provide the necessary details to identify the shipment that needs to be canceled.

200.description: The shipment cancellation request was processed successfully.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelRequest.description: The request body for canceling a shipment operation through the DELETE method. This schema is expected to receive a string representation, likely indicating a specific cancellation request.

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the shipment cancellation.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the shipment after the cancellation attempt.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation response.

audit.description: Audit information related to the cancellation operation.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelResponse_2.description: Response schema for the successful cancellation of a shipment.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who initiated the cancellation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the cancellation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information regarding the audit trail of the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
